title: Run manifest
description:
Written by `qa-orchestrator` BEFORE user-agent starts, and sealed with `pqa seal`, which records a digest in run.lock. The review gate refuses to advance if run.json changed after sealing.

The ordering is the whole point (DESIGN.md section 3): stopping conditions decided during execution are decided by the party with an interest in the outcome. Deciding them in advance and hashing them removes that option rather than discouraging it.

card_digest.description: Digest of the persona card as loaded. Binds the run to exact card content, so a card edited mid-run invalidates the run instead of silently changing the rules.

scenario.description: Optional. When present, the run is persona x scenario: the task, entry point, success criteria, scope and perturbations come from scenarios/<id>.yaml rather than being hard-wired into the persona card. Copied in at `pqa new-run` time so the sealed manifest is self-contained, and verified against the scenario file by the review gate.

scenario_digest.description: Digest of the scenario file as loaded. A scenario edited after sealing invalidates the run, the same way an edited persona card does.

perturbations.description: Sealed copy. persona-drift-check reads these from run.json, never from the scenario file, so what is injected is what was sealed.

build.description: Commit sha, version, or build number. Without this, cross-run comparison compares nothing in particular.

step_budget.description: Hard ceiling on observation records. A blunt instrument by design -- the right value is empirical and app-specific, which is why it is configuration and not a constant.

success_criteria.description: Copied at seal time so the run manifest is self-contained: from the scenario when the run has one, otherwise from the persona card.

criteria_source.description: Where success_criteria came from. The gate checks it against the bound scenario or card.

allow_unreachable.description: Whether 'provably unreachable' is an acceptable end state. Usually yes: a criterion that cannot be met is a finding, not a failure of the run.

no_state_change_steps.description: Consecutive steps with no observable state change before the run terminates as blocked.

in_scope_surfaces.description: From the scenario. Surface prefixes the session is expected to stay within; the gate warns on observations outside them.

reinject_every_steps.description: Cadence at which persona-drift-check reinserts the persona summary and writes a persona_injection record.

enforce_never_uses.description: When true, a never_uses hit fails the drift check rather than warning. Set false only while calibrating a new card's vocabulary list.
